item: Lab browser versions match the analytics top-5 (navigator.userAgent or About dialog)
OS regional settings pinned — UTC plus the release timezone / en-US locale verified via Intl.DateTimeFormat
Display scales exercised: 100% / 125% / 150% / 200% / 3x DPR with screenshots
Network baseline fixed (20 Mbps down / 50 ms latency) so layout tests are comparable
Clean profile: fresh incognito window / no extensions / no cached credentials or prior consent
Hardware acceleration on for the main run; fallback verified with it off (chrome://gpu / about:support)
CSS Grid sidebar and main panel align in Chromium / WebKit / Gecko
backdrop-filter glass header frosts in Chrome/Safari/Edge and degrades to solid bar in Firefox
CSS custom properties (--nav-width) resolve and update on resize in every engine
Container queries reflow the widget cards when the dashboard panel resizes
scroll-snap carousel snaps to KPI cards on touch and on wheel
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) matches the OS theme in every browser
Intersection Observer lazy table loads rows as the user scrolls in Safari / Firefox / Chrome
Intl.DateTimeFormat renders the date picker identically under en-GB and es-ES
ResizeObserver re-renders charts when the sidebar collapses
navigator.clipboard copies the KPI value; execCommand fallback works in Firefox ESR
dvh units resize the mobile layout as the iOS Safari toolbar shows and hides
fetch calls cancelled with AbortController leave no hanging requests after route changes
<input type="date"> submits the ISO value 2026-02-14 regardless of native picker format
<input type="number"> respects min/max on mobile virtual keyboards
autocomplete="email" autofills without breaking validation in Chrome saved profiles
Custom <select> opens above the virtual keyboard on iOS
File picker with accept=".csv" filters correctly in Firefox and Edge
Zoom 200%-400%: sidebar reflows / no horizontal scroll / every control stays reachable
JavaScript disabled: core metrics still visible with a graceful-degradation message
prefers-reduced-motion: no animated transitions / static fallback renders
320 x 568 viewport: layout usable / no overlapping text
TLS 1.2-only network: no mixed-content warnings / fonts still load
Do Not Track enabled: analytics scripts respect the signal where declared
